request.state: - alert: Enter at least one of weight, body fat, or skeletal muscle mass

tells_what_to_enter.instructions: The text is the error a form shows after the user pressed Save with every field empty. Does it tell the user what to enter?

tone.instructions: Which describes this error message for the user who sees it?

criteria.actionable: Says what the user should do next, politely and briefly
criteria.vague: Says something went wrong without saying what to do
criteria.blaming: Blames the user or is rude
